content_of_post_to_comment: Why would it be hard to imagine a student doing this? If kids could do it in 2008, they can do it now. And if they can’t, that’s an easy way to filter kids out of university. I think it’s on faculty and administration to have strict standards that they keep students to. Saying kids can’t accomplish this confuses the matter because they obviously can. Students have done this sort of thing for a century without anyone even blinking. If a professor finds that 90% of the class isn’t doing the reading and is then dropping out, that’s good. A university isn’t a waiting room for real life or a nursery. It’s a place where, in the US, people pay a lot of money to learn.
